meta.description: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow — formerly Uttar Pradesh Technical University (UPTU).

full_name: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University
description: State technical university affiliating ~800 colleges across Uttar Pradesh. Offers B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA, MCA, Pharmacy, and Architecture programs. Follows CBCS with UGC 10-point grading.

academic_calendar.details: Odd semester: Jul-Dec, Even semester: Jan-Jun. Exams typically in Nov-Dec (odd) and May-Jun (even).

available.name: AKTU 2019 Pattern
available.description: Current CBCS pattern with 5 units, 100 marks per subject (70 ESE + 30 internal)

available.name: AKTU 2021 Pattern (NEP)
available.description: NEP-aligned pattern with 5 units, 100 marks per subject, enhanced internal assessment
